summary: Advanced 5-day internal communications and employee engagement training. Build strategies, campaigns, and dashboards that leaders trust. Enroll your team today.
lede: Internal communications connects employees with organizational priorities through clear, coordinated messages that support engagement. Designed for professionals who already manage communication or engagement, this course helps them build a practical system for planning and evaluating that work. Participants learn to audit channels and feedback, segment audiences and map employee journeys, and design campaigns with measurable objectives and outcomes.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for professionals who already manage communication and engagement activities and now need to operate as strategic advisors and designers of integrated internal communications and employee engagement systems.
audience: People Analytics or HR Insights Lead
modules: Strategic Role of Internal Communications in Engagement
Auditing Internal Communications and Engagement Baseline
Audience Segmentation, Personas, and Employee Journeys
Designing Internal Communications Strategy and Governance
Message Frameworks, Content Design, and Leadership Voice
Digital Workplace Channels: Email, Intranet, Teams, and Viva
Executive Storytelling, Reporting, and Implementation Roadmap
prerequisites: This is an advanced-level course designed for experienced internal communicators, HR, and engagement professionals. You should have 5+ years of experience in internal communications, employee engagement, HR, or corporate communications, including hands-on responsibility for campaigns or engagement initiatives. You should be comfortable interpreting employee survey data and basic digital analytics (open rates, click-throughs, channel usage). No coding or programming is required. Experience with at least one digital platform such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Workplace, or an intranet solution is recommended but not mandatory. All frameworks and tools will be taught at operational application level, with advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows covered conceptually and through configuration examples, not deep technical engineering.
